arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse
# Test using < and ^ as types (no other type specified)
try:
    r = parse.parse('{:<}', 'hello world')
    print('Result:', r)
except Exception as e:
    print('Error:', e)

try:
    r = parse.parse('{:^}', 'hello world')
    print('Result:', r)
except Exception as e:
    print('Error:', e)
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
